ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Intercollegiate Athletics 4 credit hours Course Description: Throughout this course we will examine the Naitonal Collegiate Athletic Asssociation (NCAA) and intercollegiate athletics. This course is designed to provide a conceptual and practical understanding of the administration and management of Division I, II, and III intercollegiate athletic programs. Through the use of various course materials, students will understand historical, legal, financial, educational, and diversity related issues which pertain to intercollegiate athletics.
